claim: The daughter of Muahammadu Buhari (the President of Nigeria) is a board member of the Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation (NNPC).
justification: Multiple high-confidence evidence items from the retrieval-based fact-checker, including references to an official NNPC press release dated June 20, 2019, and consistent reports from credible Nigerian news outlets like ThisDay, The Guardian, and Premium Times, strongly support that Zahra Buhari was appointed to the NNPC board and was actively serving as of October 19, 2020. Although the knowledge-only fact-checker refuted the claim with high-confidence evidence of a denial and an official reconstitution list, this is outweighed by the corroborated, specific evidence supporting the appointment, which is deemed more trustworthy given the detailed sourcing and lack of contradictions in the assessments.
